documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS
Intimation Of Grant Of Options Under OFSS Stock Plan 2014

analysis.summary: Oracle Financial Services Software reported a strong performance for financial year 2025-26, with consolidated revenues reaching 76.7 billion representing a 12% increase year-on-year and net income rising to 26.4 billion reflecting an 11% increase. The company maintained solid financial discipline with an operating margin of 44% and a net margin of 34%. Management highlighted accelerated AI-led innovation and the expansion of the cloud services portfolio for the banking industry. Additionally, the Board approved two interim dividends totaling 400 per share for the financial year. Oracle Financial Services Software Limited reported consolidated revenues of ₹68.5 billion for fiscal year 2025, representing a 7% increase over the previous year.

demand_outlook.claim: The outlook for the industry is one of progressive modernization, balancing innovation, efficiency, and customer value with strong controls, compliance, and trust.
demand_outlook.quote: The outlook for the industry is one of progressive modernization, with institutions seeking to balance innovation, efficiency, and customer value with strong controls, compliance, and trust.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geopolitical challenges, and shifting technology trends during the financial year.
demand_outlook.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges and shifting technology trends - all leading to demand challenges in the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: License & Cloud revenues grew 13% over financial year 2023-24, driven by an increasing demand for cloud-native banking solutions.
demand_outlook.quote: Driven by an increasing demand for our cloud-native banking solutions, our License & Cloud revenues grew 13% over financial year 2023-24.

demand_outlook.claim: Banks are facing immense pressure to deliver digital delight at scale while complying with regulations at the lowest cost.
demand_outlook.quote: With an increasingly tech savvy customer base which is spoilt for choice, banks are under intense pressure to deliver “digital delight” at scale with complete compliance to regulations and at the lowest possible cost.

demand_outlook.claim: Financial institutions are increasingly looking at cloud-available solutions on a new architecture adaptable to rapid change.
demand_outlook.quote: Banks are increasingly looking at solutions delivered on a new architecture which is adaptable to rapid change and is available on the cloud.

demand_outlook.claim: The banking and financial services industry is undergoing significant transformation driven by rapid changes in technology, business environment, regulatory mandates and customer expectations.
demand_outlook.quote: The banking and financial services industry is undergoing a significant transformation driven by rapid changes in technology, business environment, regulatory mandates and customer expectations.

capex_expansion.claim: The company significantly expanded its cloud services portfolio for the banking industry with multiple new product launches during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: This year, we significantly expanded our cloud services portfolio for the banking industry with the launch of Oracle Banking Retail Lending Servicing Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Collections Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Cash Management Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Supply Chain Management Cloud Service, and Oracle Banking Trade Finance Cloud Service.

margins_costs.claim: The net margin remained strong at 34% during the financial year.
margins_costs.quote: Net income rose to ₹ 26.4 billion, reflecting an 11% increase year-on-year, while the net margin remained strong at 34%.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintained strong financial discipline resulting in an operating margin of 44%.
margins_costs.quote: We also continued to maintain strong financial discipline, resulting in an operating margin of 44%, reflecting the Company's consistent focus on execution and operational efficiency.

margins_costs.claim: The operating margin for the financial year rose to 44% compared to 42% in the last financial year.
margins_costs.quote: We continued to maintain a strong financial discipline while driving the growth, and our operating margin for the financial year rose to 44% as compared to 42% in the last financial year.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintained a track record of delivering consistent high profitability metrics among the best in the industry.
margins_costs.quote: We are proud that we have maintained a track record of delivering consistent high profitability metrics which are amongst the best in our industry.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated operating expenses for the financial year ended March 31, 2024 were ₹36,185.60 million.

orders_capacity.claim: The company signed multiple multi-million dollar deals with marquee customers worldwide during the financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: Your Company signed a number of multi-million dollar deals with marquee customers across the world which are a testimony to the excellence of our products through continuing R&D, our track record of delivering high quality implementations, and providing reliable support.

orders_capacity.claim: Fiscal year 2024 saw license wins of $137M, which is the highest ever for the company and registers a 44% growth over the last fiscal.
orders_capacity.quote: The fiscal year 2024 saw license wins of $137M – highest ever for the Company, registering a 44% growth over last fiscal.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's dedicated in-house R&D centers have produced IT products used by banks in more than 150 countries.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company’s dedicated in-house R&D centers have produced a number of IT products that are used by banks in more than 150 countries around the world for running their critical operations.

orders_capacity.claim: As of March 31, 2024, the company had 8,754 employees including employees of subsidiaries.
orders_capacity.quote: As of March 31, 2024, your Company had 8,754 employees (March 31, 2023 – 8,593) including employees of the subsidiaries.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved two interim dividends totaling 400 per share for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board approved two interim dividends totaling ₹ 400 per share for FY 2025-26.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved an interim dividend of ₹265 per share for the financial year 2024-25, which is 10.4% higher than the dividend paid in the last financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board was pleased to approve an interim dividend of ₹ 265 per share for the financial year 2024-25, 10.4% higher than the dividend paid in the last financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors declared an interim dividend of ₹240 per share for the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: On the strength of the performance, the Board was pleased to declare an interim dividend of ₹ 240 per share for the financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has not transferred any amount to the reserves during the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has not transferred any amount to the reserves during the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: During the financial year 2023-24, the company did not accept any deposits within the meaning of Sections 73 and 76 of the Act.
capital_allocation.quote: During the financial year 2023-24, the Company has not accepted any deposits within the meaning of Sections 73 and 76 of the Act and as such, no amount of principal or interest was outstanding as of the date of the Balance Sheet.

risks_headwinds.claim: The business landscape was driven by global uncertainties, geopolitical challenges, and shifting technology trends leading to demand challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges and shifting technology trends - all leading to demand challenges in the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fiscal year 2024 was fraught with several uncertainties including continued and expanding geopolitical conflicts and economic slowdowns.
risks_headwinds.quote: Fiscal year 2024 was fraught with several uncertainties including continued and expanding geopolitical conflicts, economic slowdowns, highly visible failures of some banks in the western world, and tectonic technology shifts with increasing usage of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) and machine learning (ML).

management_commitments.claim: The Board declared a second interim dividend of 270 per equity share on April 22, 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company ("the Board") declared 1st interim dividend of ₹ 130 per equity share and 2nd interim dividend of ₹ 270 per equity share of ₹ 5 each on October 17, 2025 and April 22, 2026, respectively, for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to delivering sustainable value, pioneering innovation, and maintaining high standards of governance.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering sustainable value, pioneering innovation and maintaining the highest standards of governance.

management_commitments.claim: The company looks forward to an exciting future achieving newer and more challenging milestones by marching together with all stakeholders.
management_commitments.quote: Marching together with all the stakeholders, we look forward to an exciting future achieving newer and more challenging milestones.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
